definitions.planned_definition: The planned duration of the project schedule
definitions.real_definition: The real total project duration (known after the project's finish)
definitions.authenticity_project_definition: The authenticity of all static project data
definitions.authenticity_tracking_definition: The authenticity of all project progress data for each tracking period (N.A. is used when not available)
definitions.authenticity_code_legend: Overview refers to colour coding and the 2015 paper; it does not define G/O/Y individually
definitions.real_unit: not explicitly specified in Overview Real duration entry
definitions.calendars: working/calendar day basis, hours/day and calendar equivalence are not established by Overview

target_definition: Signed total project duration deviation; real minus planned. Negative means early; not IFC-caused extra work or start-date slippage.
unresolved_assumptions: Day-equivalence and project calendar comparability require project-level evidence; no hours/day conversion inferred.
G/O/Y are preserved source codes; Overview provides no explicit code-to-authenticity legend. G/G is only a conservative screen.
Updates include revised schedules/precedences: the baseline must be verified as the original prediction-time plan.
Early/late disagreement is a review blocker; resolution requires source_issue_reviewed and evidence, never editing original durations.
Name-based related groups can overgroup generic names and miss other shared projects; they do not prove independence.
Absence from Known Problems does not certify a record. The sheet contains an out-of-scope project issue.
Summary rows are never observations; missing outcomes and features stay missing. No split, imputation or model training.
